export.help: Get the data of your account (account, profile, settings, sports and consent records) as a JSON file. Possible once a day.
export.rateLimited: You already downloaded your data in the last 24 hours. You can try again tomorrow.

delete.help: You request the deletion of your account; you can change your mind within 30 days.
delete.title: Delete your account
delete.grace: After your request your account waits for 30 days: your profile is hidden and you cannot do anything new. During this time you can sign in and cancel the request.
delete.permanent: After 30 days your login, profile, settings and sport profiles are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
delete.kept: Records of which legal text you accepted and when may be kept, linked to an anonymous record without your name or email (legal review pending).
delete.exportFirst: You may want to download your data before deleting: Settings › Account › Download my data.
delete.passwordHint: For your security, please enter your password again.

pending.title: Your account will be deleted
pending.body: Your account will be deleted permanently on {{date}}. Until then you can change your mind.
pending.meanwhile: Meanwhile your profile is hidden and nothing new can be done with your account.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: You cannot do anything with this account right now. If you think this is a mistake, get in touch.
